about: Activity Monitor's menus in the session's menu bar, as macOS's (docs/adr/0021-menu-bar.mdx, docs/adr/0063-activity-monitor.mdx): it declares Edit and View with Bloom's Menubar, Edit's editing commands acting on the focused field and Find… (Ctrl+F) its own command, which gives the process search field the keyboard with its text selected, as a Mac's Find takes its field. Ctrl+F in the window finds without the bar; Find… from the bar, its field already holding text, selects that text, so what is typed next replaces it.

steps.name: shown and made active by a press on the table's empty space: Edit then View in the bar, Edit's editing items disabled (no field has focus), Find… enabled
Ctrl+F in the window: the search field has the keyboard, once, with no bar
what is typed goes to the field: the two known processes alone
Edit opens in the shell's bar with each command's chord as Ctrl; the field keeps focus
Find… from the bar: the keyboard is the window's again (the pointer back over it), the field's text selected, the command run once
what is typed next replaces the selected text: oxyos-test-idle alone
